_about: What a datacenter pays: the figures the page shows for the months of the public hourly file (site/public/datacenter/erw_2026_datacenter_hourly.csv and erw_2026_datacenter_carbon.csv, the page's files built 12 November 2026: ERCOT's LZ_NORTH, a flat load bought in real time, the last twelve months 2025-11 to 2026-10), each with its check key (the page's data cell or check key; dc|... is the page's inputs at their defaults) and the tolerance to which the replication must meet it (half of the page's last shown digit). Read by session 1491 from a local build of main (6 November 2026, about 09:00 UTC) in the internal view. Since session 3779 the figures the page computes from its files are written by figures_of_the_page.py from the page's own code (site/scripts/datacenter-page-figures.mjs) on the files of the same run; the two years by window are the live set's and kept as read.
